en.t: "Once again I have been cut off from life!"

units.source_text: 我喃喃自语道，"又一次啊！

en.t: Why does the Golden Pavilion try to protect me?

units.source_text: 我没有拜托它，它为什么企图将我同人生隔绝呢？

en.t: I never asked it to; why does it try to cut me off from life?

units.source_text: 诚然，也许金阁是从堕地狱中把我拯救了出来，

en.t: True, perhaps the Golden Pavilion saved me from falling into hell,

units.source_text: 缘此，金阁使我比堕地狱的人更坏，使我成为一个比任何人都通晓地狱消息的人。"

en.t: and because of that, it made me worse than someone who had fallen into hell, and made me a person who knew the news of hell better than anyone else."
